whoWeAre.title: 1. Who We Are
whoWeAre.description: This Privacy Policy explains how NESSWIN COMPETITIONS LTD (“Nesswin”, “we”, “us”, or “our”) collects, uses, stores, shares, and protects personal data when users access our website, app, web app, competitions, and related services (the “Platform”).

scope.title: 2. Scope
scope.description: This Privacy Policy applies to all visitors, users, participants, customers, and winners who interact with the Platform, including when creating an account, entering competitions, making payments, submitting a Free Postal Entry, contacting support, or claiming a prize.

dataCollect.title: 3. Personal Data We May Collect
dataCollect.description: We may collect identity data, contact data, account data, verification data, transaction data, competition data, winner data, technical data, and communications.

whyUseData.title: 4. Why We Use Your Data
whyUseData.description: We use personal data to create and manage accounts, verify eligibility, process entries, run competitions, select winners, prevent fraud, verify winners, deliver prizes, communicate with users, comply with legal obligations, and improve the Platform.

sharingData.title: 5. Sharing Your Data
sharingData.description: We may share data with payment processors, KYC providers, SMS providers, hosting and analytics providers, logistics partners, professional advisers, and authorities where legally required. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.

rights.title: 6. Your Rights
rights.description: Depending on applicable law, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, restrict, object, withdraw consent where applicable, request portability, and lodge a complaint with a relevant supervisory authority.

contact.title: 7. Contact
contact.description: For privacy questions or requests, please contact us at:

adultsOnly.title: 1. 18+ Only
adultsOnly.description: Nesswin competitions are strictly for adults aged 18 or over. We may require age verification before allowing participation or before releasing a prize.

playResponsibly.title: 2. Play Responsibly
playResponsibly.description: Nesswin encourages all users to participate responsibly and within their financial means. Never spend more than you can comfortably afford to lose. Participation should always be for entertainment and excitement, not as a way to make money or solve financial problems.

warningSigns.title: 3. Warning Signs
warningSigns.description: You should stop and seek support if you:
signs: Feel pressure to chase losses or “win back” money
Hide your spending from family or friends
Use borrowed money or essential funds to enter competitions
Feel stressed, anxious, or out of control about participation

selfExclusion.title: 4. Self-Exclusion / Support Requests
selfExclusion.description: If you would like to restrict your access, request account limits, or ask us to block your participation, please contact us at:

contact.title: 5. Contact
contact.description: For responsible play or account restriction requests, please reach out to:

overview.title: 1. Overview
overview.description: Nesswin offers a free alternative method of entry by post (“Free Postal Entry”) for eligible competitions, subject to the Terms & Conditions and any competition-specific rules shown on the relevant competition page.

eligibility.title: 2. Eligibility
eligibility.description: To submit a valid Free Postal Entry, the participant must:
requirements: Have a registered Nesswin account (unless stated)
Have a verified mobile phone number
Correctly answer the skill question (if required)
Ensure entry is received before deadline

howToEnter.title: 3. How to Enter
howToEnter.description: Send a handwritten postcard or handwritten letter containing:
requirements: Correct answer to the skill question

equalChance.title: 4. Equal Chance of Winning
equalChance.description: A valid Free Postal Entry that complies with the rules will be treated as a valid competition entry and included in the same draw as valid paid entries. Each valid Free Postal Entry has the same chance of winning as a valid paid entry.

contact.title: 5. Contact
contact.description: For questions relating to Free Postal Entry, please contact us at:

overview.title: 1. General Overview
overview.p1: These Competition Rules apply to all skill-based competitions operated by NESSWIN COMPETITIONS LTD, unless specific rules on a competition page state otherwise.
overview.p2: By entering a competition, you agree to these Competition Rules, the Nesswin Terms & Conditions, and any prize-specific conditions shown on the relevant competition page.

howItWorks.title: 2. How It Works
steps: Create or log in to your account
Verify your phone number by SMS / OTP
Answer the skill-based qualifying question correctly
howItWorks.footerNotice: Your entry only becomes valid once the payment is successful and the entry is correctly recorded in Nesswin’s systems.

qualifyingQuestion.title: 3. Skill-Based Qualifying Question
qualifyingQuestion.p1: Every competition requires 1 skill-based qualifying question only. The question may be multiple choice, text-based, or image-based. For example, the user may see an image first and then choose the correct answer from 4 answer options.
qualifyingQuestion.p2: Nesswin may maintain an internal pool of multiple qualifying questions and may display one question randomly from that pool. This means different users may see different questions. Only users who answer the applicable question correctly may proceed to ticket purchase.

ticketPurchases.title: 4. Ticket Purchases
ticketPurchases.p1: Once the user answers the question correctly, they may purchase one or more tickets, subject to availability and any applicable limits. Tickets are only valid after successful payment.
ticketPurchases.p2: All purchases are final unless the competition is cancelled by Nesswin or a refund is required by law.

closing.title: 5. Competition Closing
closing.description: A competition will usually close when all tickets are sold out or when the stated closing date/time is reached. Nesswin may reasonably extend, shorten, suspend, or cancel a competition for technical, security, legal, compliance, operational, fraud prevention, or force majeure reasons.

winnerSelection.title: 6. Winner Selection
winnerSelection.p1: At the end of a competition, Nesswin will review all entries and identify all Valid Entries. A Valid Entry is one that answered the qualifying question correctly, completed successful payment, and complied with the applicable rules.
winnerSelection.p2: Unless otherwise stated on the relevant competition page, the winner is selected randomly from the pool of valid entries that answered correctly.

randomDraw.title: 7. Random Draw / RandomDraws-Type System
randomDraw.p1: To support fairness and transparency, Nesswin may use a third-party random draw tool or platform, including a platform of the type commonly known as RandomDraws, or another equivalent system selected by Nesswin.
randomDraw.p2: Nesswin may retain screenshots, certificates, recordings, or evidence of the draw. Nesswin reserves the right to change the third-party tool used, provided the process remains fair and consistent with the competition rules.

liveDraws.title: 8. Live Draws and Instagram Transparency
liveDraws.p1: For transparency and trust, Nesswin may present the draw live on the official Nesswin Instagram account, via Instagram Live, or through another official Nesswin channel.
liveDraws.p2: During or around the draw, Nesswin may display participant usernames, first names + last initials, ticket quantities, the eligible participant list, and the draw process itself. Nesswin may also upload replay videos, winner announcement clips, draw recordings, and prize handover videos.

winnerContact.title: 9. Winner Contact and Verification
winnerContact.p1: Winners may be contacted by email, SMS, phone, in-app notification, or another reasonable method.
winnerContact.p2: Before a prize is awarded, the winner may be required to provide ID, proof of age, proof of address, proof of ownership or authorisation for the payment method used, confirmation of phone verification, and any additional documents reasonably required for security, fraud prevention, KYC/AML, or compliance. Failure to provide requested documents may result in disqualification and selection of an alternative winner.

prizeDelivery.title: 10. Prize Delivery / Handover
prizeDelivery.p1: Prize fulfilment depends on the type of prize and may include physical delivery, in-person collection, prize handover filming, direct booking via a travel provider, digital delivery, or another reasonable fulfilment method.
prizeDelivery.p2: Timing is not guaranteed and may depend on the prize type, winner location, supplier availability, logistics, compliance checks, taxes/customs, and third-party providers.

winnerPublicity.title: 11. Winner Publicity and Prize Handover Content
winnerPublicity.p1: If you win, Nesswin may, for transparency and promotional purposes, use content related to the winner announcement, the draw, prize handover, prize receipt, photos, videos, testimonials, social media posts, and promotional clips.
winnerPublicity.p2: Where reasonably possible, Nesswin may choose to show your username, first name, or first name + last initial instead of your full legal name. Nesswin may publish such content on the website, app/web app, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, X (Twitter), paid or organic advertising, and PR or marketing materials.

restrictions.title: 12. Important Restrictions
restrictions.description: Nesswin may disqualify or cancel entries where it reasonably believes there has been fraud, multiple abusive accounts, false identity, false documents, unauthorised payment use, bots or scripts, manipulation attempts, chargeback abuse, breach of rules, abusive conduct, or legal non-compliance.

finalDecisions.title: 13. Final Decisions
finalDecisions.description: Nesswin’s decisions regarding question validity, entry validity, winner eligibility, draw method, prize fulfilment, disqualification, and operational integrity are final, except in the case of manifest error.

By creating an account, accessing the Platform, purchasing a ticket, submitting a Free Postal Entry, or participating in any competition, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agreed to these Terms.

natureOfPlatform.title: 2. Nature of the Platform
natureOfPlatform.p1: Nesswin operates a platform offering skill-based prize competitions that may allow eligible users to win prizes, including but not limited to:
prizes: And other prizes advertised on the Platform.
natureOfPlatform.p2: Nesswin competitions are intended to operate as skill-based competitions and not as pure games of chance, gambling, or traditional lotteries.
natureOfPlatform.p3: To participate validly, a user must:
rules: Correctly answer the applicable skill-based qualifying question.
Complete a valid entry in accordance with the relevant competition rules, whether by paid entry or by the Free Postal Entry route where available.

eligibility.title: 3. Eligibility
eligibility.description: To use the Platform and enter competitions, you must:
requirements: Be 18 years old or over at the time of entry.
Have legal capacity to enter into a binding contract.
Provide accurate, complete, and up-to-date information.
Use a payment method that you are legally authorised to use.
Not be prohibited by law from participating in your jurisdiction.
eligibility.p2: Nesswin reserves the right to restrict or refuse participation from any country, territory, or jurisdiction for legal, regulatory, sanctions, compliance, operational, or risk reasons. Employees, contractors, consultants, partners, and immediate family members directly connected to the operation of Nesswin may be excluded from participation.

accountRegistration.title: 4. Account Registration
accountRegistration.description: Access to certain features requires the creation of an account. During registration, we may request:
accountRegistration.warningText: You agree that all information provided is true, accurate, complete, and current. False, misleading, incomplete, or unverifiable information may result in: account suspension, entry cancellation, prize forfeiture, or permanent account closure.

phoneVerification.title: 5. Mandatory Phone Verification
phoneVerification.p1: A verified mobile phone number is mandatory in order to participate in any competition. This requirement applies to all sign-up and login methods, including where a user registers or logs in via Apple Sign-In, Google Sign-In, or any other third-party authentication method.
phoneVerification.p2: Nesswin may require verification via SMS one-time password (OTP), verification code, or any similar verification process.

usernameDisplay.title: 6. Username and Public Display
usernameDisplay.description: Users may be required or invited to create a username. Nesswin may display the following for transparency purposes, including in participant lists, winner pages, draw displays, promotional content, and social media announcements:

ticketPurchases.title: 7. Ticket Purchases and Payments
ticketPurchases.description: An entry submitted via paid entry is only valid once:
requirements: The applicable skill question has been correctly answered.
The entry has been correctly recorded in our systems.
rules: Except where required by law or where a competition is cancelled by Nesswin, tickets are non-refundable.
A failed, reversed, disputed, refunded, or charged-back payment may lead to automatic cancellation of the related tickets.
ticketPurchases.postalDisclaimer: For the avoidance of doubt, entries submitted through the Free Postal Entry route are governed by Section 8 and do not require payment, but must still comply with the applicable skill-based qualifying question and all relevant competition rules.

freePostalEntry.title: 8. Free Postal Entry
freePostalEntry.p1: Nesswin offers a free alternative method of entry by post (“Free Postal Entry”) for certain competitions, subject to these Terms and any competition-specific rules displayed on the relevant competition page. Unless otherwise expressly stated on the relevant competition page, an eligible participant may submit one (1) free postal entry per competition.

noRefund.title: 9. No Refund Policy
noRefund.description: Except where required by applicable law or where a competition is cancelled by Nesswin:
rules: No refund is due if you do not win.
No refund is due if you change your mind.
No refund is due because you misunderstood the competition rules.
No refund is due once a valid order has been completed.

timing.title: 10. Competition Timing and Availability
timing.description: Each competition page may include prize details, ticket price, total number of tickets, number of tickets remaining, estimated closing date/time, estimated draw date/time, special conditions, and prize-specific rules. A competition may close on the stated date/time, when all tickets are sold out, if cancelled or suspended by Nesswin, or in any other manner specified on the relevant page.

winnerSelection.title: 11. Winner Selection and Draw Process
winnerSelection.description: At the close of a competition, Nesswin will identify all Valid Entries, meaning entries that:
requirements: Correctly answered the applicable skill-based qualifying question.
Completed successful payment or were validly submitted via the Free Postal Entry route.
Comply with these Terms and the relevant Competition Rules.
winnerSelection.p2: Unless otherwise stated on the relevant competition page, the winner is selected at random from the pool of valid entries that answered correctly. Nesswin may use a third-party random draw platform or service, including a platform of the type commonly known as RandomDraws, or any equivalent tool or system chosen by Nesswin to support fairness, transparency, and traceability.

winnerNotification.title: 12. Winner Notification
winnerNotification.description: Winners may be contacted using: email, phone call, SMS, in-app notification, or any other reasonable contact method.

winnerVerification.title: 13. Winner Verification
winnerVerification.description: Before any prize is awarded, Nesswin may require the winner to provide:

prizes.title: 14. Prizes and Fulfilment
prizes.description: Prizes are as described on the relevant competition page. Prize images and videos may be illustrative only. The actual prize may vary reasonably depending on availability, location, supplier, exact model, or specification. Unless expressly stated otherwise, no cash alternative is guaranteed.

promotionalConsent.title: 15. Promotional Consent
promotionalConsent.description: By entering a competition, each participant acknowledges and agrees that, if selected as a winner, Nesswin may use certain content connected to the winner, the win, and the prize handover for transparency, proof of prize fulfilment, promotion of the Platform, and marketing. This may include:

chargebacks.title: 16. Chargebacks, Fraud and Abuse
chargebacks.description: If a participant initiates an abusive or unjustified chargeback, fraudulent payment dispute, or otherwise attempts to recover funds improperly:
rules: Any pending or potential prize may be suspended or voided.
The account may be suspended or permanently closed.
Nesswin may refuse to release any prize.

availability.title: 17. Platform Availability
availability.description: We do not guarantee uninterrupted, error-free, or defect-free operation of the Platform or related services. Nesswin may modify, suspend, update, restrict, or discontinue all or part of the Platform at any time.

intellectualProperty.title: 18. Intellectual Property
intellectualProperty.description: All content on the Platform, including text, logos, branding, graphics, videos, designs, interfaces, software, databases, and promotional materials, belongs to Nesswin or its licensors and is protected by intellectual property laws.

limitationOfLiability.title: 19. Limitation of Liability
limitationOfLiability.description: Nothing in these Terms excludes or limits liability where it would be unlawful to do so, including for death or personal injury caused by negligence, fraud, fraudulent misrepresentation, or any liability that cannot legally be excluded.

governingLaw.title: 20. Governing Law and Jurisdiction
governingLaw.description: These Terms are governed by the laws of England and Wales. Any dispute, claim, or matter arising out of or in connection with the Platform, competitions, entries, prizes, or these Terms shall be subject to the jurisdiction of the courts of England and Wales, subject to any mandatory consumer rights that may apply in the participant’s country of residence.
